| # Object 0x1008 manufacturer device name {#object-0x1008-manufacturer-device-name-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the contains the device name.

 

  Index           0x1008
  --------------- --------------------------
  Name            Manufacturer Device Name
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       Visible String
  Category        Optional
  Access          const
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     No
  Default Value   Name of BODAS BSW

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   By default, it contains the name of BODAS BSW.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------
